'''Lott Dod's palace''' was a large fortress located on the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse world]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was the personal residence of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==Description==
[[File:NeimoidianPaintings-SSbts.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Paintings in the grand hall gallery]]
Dod's palace was located on one of the many [[Bridge city/Legends|bridge cities]] on Cato Neimoidia. The central focus of the structure was an circular tower located at the top of a large stairway. There were circular landing pads to either side of a wide walkway leading to the entrance stairs. The main doors opened into an opulent grand hall decorated in deep scarlet and gold colors with a gallery of artwork depicting historical Neimoidians. Sweeping staircases led to upper levels of the palace, including living quarters. The mansion had a formal dining room Dod used to entertain guests. The palace also boasted a vast library.

==History==
[[File:LottDodandFriends.png|thumb|right|300px|Lott Dod (center) in his palace with two other Neimoidians]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] suspected [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]], the senator representing the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], of conspiring with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. They needed a trustworthy senator to get close to Clovis to determine the extent of his treachery. Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] was selected by the council due to her past relationship with Clovis. She at first refused until she was informed of his suspected Separatist ties. She invited Clovis to dinner at the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] [[Dining commons/Legends|dining commons]] where he expressed his interest in rekindling both their professional and personal relationship. When Amidala expressed a similar desire, Clovis asked that she accompany him to [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] where he was to have a meeting with Trade Federation senator Lott Dod. She agreed and they traveled together aboard her personal [[J-type star skiff]] with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Typho]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] disguised as the ship's pilot.

They arrived on Cato Neimoidia and landed at Lott Dod's palace. After disembarking from the skiff, they were greeted by Dod and two of his gold-colored [[BD-3000 luxury droid/Legends|servant droids]]. Dod led them into the main foyer of the palace where Clovis requested Amidala be shown to her quarters while he and Dod conducted their business meeting. After she and C-3PO were left alone in her suite, she left to reconnoiter the palace under the guise of wanted to take a walk.

At the same time, Clovis and Dod were meeting with [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] [[Archduke/Legends|Archduke]] [[Poggle the Lesser/Legends|Poggle the Lesser]] in the library about a massive new [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|droid foundry]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] that was largely funded by Clovis and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|Banking Clan]]. Dod and Poggle demanded a larger share of the profits than was agreed upon and Clovis refused. When they noticed Amidala approaching, the [[HoloNet transceiver/Legends|hologram projection table]] around which they were standing was quickly deactivated and their discussion stopped. Amidala stated she was wandering the library because she was lonely and desired Clovis' company. Clovis warmly greeting her and escorted her out of the library. Dod and Poggle noticed the affection their cohort showed towards his companion and conspired to poison Amidala to force Clovis to acquiesce to their demands by offering an antidote to the poison.

[[File:LottDodPalace-SSbts.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Concept art of the palace]]
That evening, Dod offered a toast to Amidala to signify their new friendship and presented her a poisoned glass to drink from. They then sat down to a formal dinner in the dining hall. At the conclusion of the meal, Amidala began to feel faint from the effects of the poison but attributed it to having stood up too quickly. Clovis escorted her on a tour of the library during which Amidala requested a drink of water.
